description: Abstract base for subject projections (ADR-0007). The metric owner derives one concrete projection per scope; QE maps a caller-supplied SubjectRef kind to the unique projection for (metric, scope). Operation metadata is defined once by the metric request contract, not by each projection.

scope.description: Required scope discriminator: a well-known instance of gts.cf.core.qe.scope.v1~. QE reads the registry-validated effective trait and maps caller-supplied SubjectRef kinds through the catalogue; scope is never encoded in the type-id name segment.

items.description: Registered metric id under the platform metric base (illustrative base pending the cross-gear naming decision, PRD section 3.2).

admitted_metrics.description: Metrics this projection admits. x-gts-ref narrowing is pattern-level only: metric registration, the instance-of relationship to the metric base, and debit admission are checked by QE at bootstrap and Gateway ingress (ADR-0007). At most one projection admits a given metric per (metric, scope) pair per deployment; narrowing this set is a breaking contract change.

type.description: The concrete owner-declared subject projection. QE selects this type from the catalogue; consumers do not supply it.
